## Decisions

- **onhold is a human-only status; agents never set or clear it themselves**: It encodes a product-priority call, not a dependency or blocker fact an agent can observe from the repo (alternatives: Reuse 'blocked' for both meanings (rejected: conflates 'can't proceed' with 'chose not to proceed', which is exactly the ambiguity that fed the PSI-081/082 rework loop found in PSI-108))
- **Hold PSI-098 (LLM layer) in addition to the two named features**: Its only consumers are chat (PSI-076), digest (PSI-077, not named) and CV parsing (PSI-082, talent); finance's own agent tool (PSI-105) does not depend on it, so holding it doesn't touch the priority pipeline, and it documents intent instead of leaving the board silent about why PSI-082 stays stuck (alternatives: Leave PSI-098 backlog)
- **PSI-109 is a design + backlog task, not an implementation this session**: Depends on PSI-104 (finance tab), still backlog; building the panel now would mean guessing the finance UI shape instead of reusing it (alternatives: Build a task-detail sheet now without the finance section, add it later)
